firstConnectionConfirmTheHost: First connection. Confirm the host fingerprint.
theServerMayHaveBeen: The server may have been reinstalled, or this may be a man-in-the-middle attack. If you are sure, delete the old entry from known_hosts, then connect.
compareWithTheOutputOf: Compare with the output of `ssh-keygen -lf /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub` on the server
copyFailedSelectTheText: Copy failed. Select the text and copy it manually.
itIsDisconnectedRightAway: It is disconnected right away and has to pair again to reconnect.
relayAccessLinkValidFor: relay access link (valid for 10 minutes, single use)
letOtherDevicesConnectTo: Let other devices connect to this computer
whenAPhoneOrAnother: When a phone or another computer cannot reach this computer (different network, or behind NAT), it can connect through a relay. Traffic is end-to-end encrypted; the relay only forwards ciphertext.
turnedOffOtherDevicesCannot: Turned off. Other devices cannot connect for now.
thisAppAlreadyUsesA: This app already uses a relay. Ask that computer for an invite and use the same relay (the relay must allow --device-invites):
theRelayOperatorGeneratesIt: (the relay operator generates it with yi-relay invite on the server; valid for 24 hours, single use):
thisLinkHasNoInvite: This link has no invite code. It works only if this computer is already registered with this relay.
noLinkEnterTheRelay: No link? Enter the relay address and invite code
inviteCodeFromYiRelay: Invite code (from yi-relay invite; leave empty if already registered)
certificateFingerprintForASelf: Certificate fingerprint (for a self-signed certificate; see the yi-relay startup log)
addThisComputerOnAnother: Add this computer on another device
generateAOneTimePairing: Generate a one-time pairing QR code. It is valid for 10 minutes and pairs a single device.
openYiConsoleHostsPair: : Open Yi Console → Hosts → Pair device → Scan, and scan the QR code on the left.
copyThePairingLinkSend: : Copy the pairing link, send it over, and paste it in Yi Console → Hosts → Pair device.
theRelayIsNotConnected: The relay is not connected yet. The other side can pair only after this side connects.
createARelayAccessLink: Create a relay access link for another computer
singleUseValidFor10: Single use, valid for 10 minutes; the relay must allow --device-invites
allPairedPhonesAndComputers: All paired phones and computers are disconnected right away and must pair again.
resetAllPreviousPairingsNo: Reset. All previous pairings no longer work.
useIfADeviceMay: Use if a device may be compromised; to remove one device, use the list above
pairingLinkReadFromThe: Pairing link read from the clipboard
thisIsARelayAccess: This is a relay access link for turning the relay on a computer (paste it in step 1 of “Let other devices connect to this computer” on that computer). To add a device, use a pairing link.
pairADeviceConnectTo: Pair a device (connect to another computer via relay)
onTheComputerYouWant: On the computer you want to connect to, open Yi Console → Hosts and find
letOtherDevicesConnectTo2: “Let other devices connect to this computer”
underThisComputerThenTurn: under this computer, then turn the relay on in step 1.
inStep2ClickGenerate: In step 2, click “Generate pairing QR code”, then “Copy pairing link” and send it here (a phone can scan the QR code). The code is valid for 10 minutes and works once.
pasteItBelowItConnects: Paste it below. It connects automatically after you save.
name: Name
leaveEmptyToUseThe: Leave empty to use the device name
onAComputerWithoutA: On a computer without a GUI, run `yi-agentd relay pair` to print a one-time pairing link and QR code
orPasteThePrivateKey: Or paste the private key (for phones)
onFirstDeployRegisterYi: On first deploy, register yi-agentd as a startup service (sessions continue after a server reboot)
letPairedPhonesReachThis: Let paired phones reach this host through this computer
theLocalDaemonIsStill: The local daemon is still running old version {{v}}. Version {{clientVersion}} is ready and takes effect after you restart the daemon.
remoteYiAgentdDoesNot: Remote yi-agentd {{v}} does not match client {{clientVersion}}.
updateYiConsoleOnThe: (Update Yi Console on the computer where this host runs.)
theTurnInProgressWill: (The turn in progress will be interrupted. Sessions are kept, and the next message resumes the context.)
addWithAPairingLink: Add with a pairing link from another computer
turnOnTheRelayAnd: Turn on the relay and create a pairing link for a phone or another computer
proxyNotificationsAndOtherSettings: Proxy, notifications, and other settings are in Preferences
